profile.reading:
This registry entry carries the name Learning GIS!, attributed to Purdue University, at an address on Agricultural Mall in West Lafayette, Tippecanoe County, Indiana. The name does not resemble how data center operators typically name their buildings. It reads instead like the title of a class exercise, a lab module, or a point placed on a map as part of a geographic information systems teaching activity, complete with an exclamation point that would be out of place in an infrastructure facility name.

Purdue University teaches GIS coursework, including hands on mapping exercises in which students or instructors add points to OpenStreetMap as part of an assignment. A student or class project point named for the activity itself, rather than for any building or business at that location, is a well documented pattern in OpenStreetMap data, and this entry fits that pattern closely.

No Purdue facilities record, department page, or IT infrastructure document describes a data center at this address, and nothing in the name or location suggests one exists there. This entry is presented here as a likely OpenStreetMap teaching or mapping exercise artifact rather than as a confirmed data center. No capacity, power, or tenancy specifications are published for it because there is no indication a dedicated facility of that kind exists at this point.

This entry does not represent a confirmed data center facility.
